sources.authors: Nicolas Bartholdi, Jeremy Blanc, Sebastien Loisel
sources.locator: Proposition 3.1, Remark 3.2, Theorems 1.3 and 1.4; perfect-odd exterior extension after Theorem 1.1
sources.role: Geometric doubling and compatibility hypotheses; existing families and earlier numerical consequences. Corollary 3.3 alone supplies pseudolines, not arbitrary straight-line realizations.

sources.title: The best polynomial bounds for the number of triangles in a simple arrangement of n pseudo-lines
sources.role: Upper bounds for simple arrangements and unused-segment/exterior-line antecedents; not used as unrestricted classical upper bounds.

sources.title: Arrangements of Lines with a Large Number of Triangles
sources.role: Older construction reproduced for comparison; source text mirror of the original article, not a claim that these comparison bounds are new.
sources.formalization_update: The ceiling baseline is proved geometrically in FurediPalasti and FurediPalastiCount. Universal.baseline_sound now proves the stronger affine formula floor(n(n-3)/3)+1+(n mod 2) for n>=4 via shifted phase and projective caps. The underlying family remains attributed to this source; first numerical priority for the affine refinement is unestablished.
sources.metadata_check: Both DOI records were checked directly against Crossref on 2026-09-22 UTC and identify the same 1984 paper.

sources.role: Published 18-series data and gallery used during the comparison and fitting searches.

sources.role: User-identified statement of the target recurrence, attributed there to the March paper; not independent proof of its universal or iterative validity.

sources.title: Exact fourteen-line Kobon configurations with 54 triangles
sources.role: Fifteen externally discovered 14:54 configurations, each independently verified by two exact counters. The lower bound is attributed to Maiorana; source assertions of unrestricted optimality are not imported as proof.
sources.changes: Original coordinate files, README and licence are preserved; certificate wrappers add independently enumerated triangles and provenance metadata. No upstream verification program was executed.

sources.title: New Lower Bounds for Convex Hull Problems in Odd Dimensions
sources.role: Primary statement of the classical all-n affine FP ceiling bound. Its three-angle perturbation is a decision-tree argument, not a universal Kobon one-line extension.

sources.title: Triangles in Euclidean Arrangements
sources.role: Historical straight-line lower-bound context and the distinction between line and pseudoline realizability.

sources.title: Clément–Bader 2007 Kobon upper-bound draft
sources.role: Reported classical envelope distinguished from BBL and Blanc simple-arrangement bounds. A literal local reading of Lemma 1's shared-pair wording has a certified counterexample; this does not refute the final upper theorem.

sources.title: Straight Line Arrangements in the Real Projective Plane
sources.authors: David Forge and Jorge Luis Ramírez Alfonsín
sources.role: Earlier extremal projective straight-line infinite families; an affine chart and interpolation argument is still required before asserting an all-n affine improvement.

sources.title: Some simple arrangements of pseudolines with a maximum number of triangles
sources.role: Historical pseudoline constructions; not treated as straight-line realizations without a separate stretchability proof.

sources.title: Triangle areas in line arrangements
sources.authors: Gábor Damásdi, Leonardo Martínez-Sandoval, Dániel T. Nagy and Zoltán Lóránt Nagy
sources.role: Modern primary-paper summary crediting the general Kobon lower construction to Füredi–Palásti. Its other triangle-area objectives are distinct from maximizing all Kobon triangles.

sources.title: The Exact Maximum Complexity of the Affine Envelope of a Line Arrangement
sources.role: Current adjacent research identified during the priority audit. Its envelope objective is not the Kobon maximum; the newest proof was not independently verified, and no theorem from it is used as a Lean premise.

sources.title: Kobon triangle problem collaboration
sources.role: Public research status and restricted multiple-point-core upper results. Its research summary is not an independently replayed proof and leaves the unrestricted problem open.

sources.title: OpenAI mathematics and AI advisory group announcement
sources.role: Official context for the user's report of internally solved problems. The announcement does not identify or provide a Kobon proof; no unpublished result is assumed by this project.

sources.title: Zenodo record 21181834, version 4
sources.role: Supersedes earlier stronger exact 22/28 claims with symmetry-restricted conclusions; the version-4 statement Kcell(28) in {238,239} is not used as a proof of unrestricted exactness.
